name: sun_altar
prompt: Create ONE low squat weathered stone altar, isolated transparent pixel-art game prop, designed for a 96x96 canvas. Northern cold underworld / winter countryside material: slate grey stone with cool blue-grey shadows, worn chipped corners, sparse dull moss and simple shallow geometric carvings, no lettering or readable runes. THREE-QUARTER TOP-DOWN game view, wide flat rectangular stone tabletop, two broad low steps, sturdy compact base, not a throne, tower, tombstone or cathedral. Empty top surface with a CLEAR flat landing area at upper center for a separate existing 16x16 golden ember sprite; do NOT draw an ember, fire, magical glow, floating orb, candles or offerings. Top visible and plain enough to place separate glow without visual clutter. Centered foot-bottom composition with2px transparent margin, actual altar roughly84px wide and56px tall, upper-left light, hard dark contour and crisp square pixel clusters, <=40 muted colors, no antialiasing or gradients. Match attached project's stone texture and palette; second reference is separate ember to reserve room for, do not include it in result. No ground patch, text, background, extra props.
